title: What is the Telegram AI support assistant?
body:
What is the Telegram AI support assistant?

In Telegram bot @AladdinchatAI_bot you can ask the ALADDIN support AI. It answers from the app FAQ and guides: antifake, kids, plans, family, network protection.

Important:
• Not Companion — answers only about the ALADDIN app.
• Telegram has no ALADDIN family-chat E2EE — do not enter passwords, SMS codes, or card data.
• Plan/family facts come from your linked account; disputes go to a human.
• First tap “Connect Telegram” (/link code), then “Ask the assistant” or send /help_ai in the bot.
